title: Chic and Cozy Designer Condo 3 Miles to Downtown
description:
Enjoy a peaceful stay at this upscale, conveniently-located condo with 3 Beds, 2 Bedrooms & 2 Full Baths! Located in a new, professionally designed condo building in hip & trendy East Nashville. FREE Parking, elevator + washer/dryer in the condo. Walk to local coffee, restaurants & a brewery. Only 10 minutes to Downtown Broadway bars and 13 min to the Grand Ole Opry! Hair salon in the building if you need a quick cut! Fully-stocked kitchen, Smart TV and everything else you’d need.

The space
HIGHLIGHTS: 

★ If you are coming with a group and need more than 1 condo, let us know! We own all the condos in this building
★ 3 Beds - 2 Kings and 1 Twin rollaway bed
★ 2 Bedrooms
★ 2 Full-size spacious bathrooms - one connected to bedroom #1 & one in the hallway
★ Room-darkening curtains in the living room & both bedrooms
★ Elevator in the building
★ Smart TV in the living room with all the streaming apps
★ Seating for 4 at the kitchen island
★ Fully-equipped kitchen with high-end appliances for all your cooking needs
★ Iron & ironing board
★ Full-length mirror
★ FREE parking
★ Walk to restaurants, coffee, a local brewery & more
★ Only 10 min drive to Downtown Broadway Bars
★ Only 13 min drive to the Grand Ole Opry
★ In-unit washer/dryer (free to use)
★ High-speed internet
★ Plenty of storage space for your clothes
★ Hair dryers, shampoo, conditioner and body wash provided
★ Adjustable thermostat
★ Hassle-free check-in with no keys, just codes 
★ Keurig Coffee Maker & K-Cups
★ Walking distance to All People Coffee, Southern Grist Brewery, Redheaded Stranger, Folk, Audrey, & more! 
★ Two Grocery stores nearby - Publix and Kroger

BEDS: 
Bedroom 1: 1 King 
Bedroom 2: 1 King 
Living Room: 1 Twin Rollaway bed with a Memory Foam Mattress

BATHROOMS: 
Bathroom 1: Full size with stand up shower connected to bedroom #1
Bathroom 2: Full size with stand up shower next to bedroom #2

After a fun day out exploring Nashville, come back to relax in this comfortable, inviting condo. The space provides a calming mix of style + comfort. All aspects of the bedrooms & living spaces were thoughtfully designed with ease + convenience in mind. Our neighborhood is very safe and charming with many beloved spots in this flourishing local area of East Nashville. The airport is only about 15 minutes away. There are plenty of Ubers, Lyft and taxis available if you choose not to bring a car. Our condo is in a great location to enjoy all the things that Nashville has to offer!
